jobs_running_has_started.name: jobs_running_has_started
jobs_running_has_started.value: "jobs"."state" <> 'running' or ("jobs"."claim_token" is not null and length(trim("jobs"."claim_token")) > 0 and "jobs"."claimed_by_actor_id" is not null and "jobs"."claimed_at" is not null and "jobs"."lease_expires_at" is not null and "jobs"."started_at" is not null and "jobs"."completed_at" is null and "jobs"."error_message" is null)

jobs_pending_is_clean.name: jobs_pending_is_clean
jobs_pending_is_clean.value: "jobs"."state" <> 'pending' or ("jobs"."claim_token" is null and "jobs"."claimed_by_actor_id" is null and "jobs"."claimed_at" is null and "jobs"."lease_expires_at" is null and "jobs"."effect_started_at" is null and "jobs"."started_at" is null and "jobs"."completed_at" is null and "jobs"."error_message" is null)

jobs_nonrunning_has_no_fence.name: jobs_nonrunning_has_no_fence
jobs_nonrunning_has_no_fence.value: "jobs"."state" = 'running' or ("jobs"."claim_token" is null and "jobs"."lease_expires_at" is null)

jobs_lease_after_claim.name: jobs_lease_after_claim
jobs_lease_after_claim.value: "jobs"."lease_expires_at" is null or ("jobs"."claimed_at" is not null and "jobs"."lease_expires_at" > "jobs"."claimed_at")

jobs_effect_after_claim.name: jobs_effect_after_claim
jobs_effect_after_claim.value: "jobs"."effect_started_at" is null or ("jobs"."claimed_at" is not null and "jobs"."effect_started_at" >= "jobs"."claimed_at")

jobs_terminal_has_completed.name: jobs_terminal_has_completed
jobs_terminal_has_completed.value: "jobs"."state" not in ('succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled') or "jobs"."completed_at" is not null

jobs_failed_has_error.name: jobs_failed_has_error
jobs_failed_has_error.value: "jobs"."state" <> 'failed' or ("jobs"."error_message" is not null and length(trim("jobs"."error_message")) > 0)

jobs_completed_attempt_has_started.name: jobs_completed_attempt_has_started
jobs_completed_attempt_has_started.value: "jobs"."state" not in ('succeeded', 'failed') or "jobs"."started_at" is not null

publications_schedule_consistent.name: publications_schedule_consistent
publications_schedule_consistent.value: ("publications"."scheduled_at" is null and "publications"."scheduled_by_actor_id" is null) or ("publications"."scheduled_at" is not null and "publications"."scheduled_by_actor_id" is not null)

publications_published_state_complete.name: publications_published_state_complete
publications_published_state_complete.value: "publications"."state" <> 'published' or ("publications"."published_at" is not null and "publications"."published_by_actor_id" is not null)

publications_unpublished_state_has_no_re.name: publications_unpublished_state_has_no_result
publications_unpublished_state_has_no_re.value: "publications"."state" = 'published' or ("publications"."published_at" is null and "publications"."published_by_actor_id" is null)

publications_failure_has_error.name: publications_failure_has_error
publications_failure_has_error.value: "publications"."state" not in ('failed', 'ambiguous') or ("publications"."error_message" is not null and length(trim("publications"."error_message")) > 0)

publisher_credentials_secret_state_valid.name: publisher_credentials_secret_state_valid
publisher_credentials_secret_state_valid.value:
(
                    "publisher_credentials"."state" in ('active', 'reconnect_required')
                    and "publisher_credentials"."encryption_version" is not null
                    and "publisher_credentials"."encryption_key_id" is not null
                    and "publisher_credentials"."access_token_ciphertext" is not null
                    and "publisher_credentials"."access_token_nonce" is not null
                    and length("publisher_credentials"."access_token_ciphertext") > 16
                    and length("publisher_credentials"."access_token_nonce") = 12
                ) or (
                    "publisher_credentials"."state" = 'revoked'
                    and "publisher_credentials"."encryption_version" is null
                    and "publisher_credentials"."encryption_key_id" is null
                    and "publisher_credentials"."access_token_ciphertext" is null
                    and "publisher_credentials"."access_token_nonce" is null
                    and "publisher_credentials"."refresh_token_ciphertext" is null
                    and "publisher_credentials"."refresh_token_nonce" is null
                )

publisher_credentials_refresh_token_enve.name: publisher_credentials_refresh_token_envelope_valid
publisher_credentials_refresh_token_enve.value:
("publisher_credentials"."refresh_token_ciphertext" is null and "publisher_credentials"."refresh_token_nonce" is null)
                or ("publisher_credentials"."refresh_token_ciphertext" is not null
                    and "publisher_credentials"."refresh_token_nonce" is not null
                    and length("publisher_credentials"."refresh_token_ciphertext") > 16
                    and length("publisher_credentials"."refresh_token_nonce") = 12)
